seo.title: Lake City Café – Dining | The Udaisarovar, Udaipur
seo.description: Home-style vegetarian food at Lake City Café, The Udaisarovar: breakfast by the lake, candle-lit dinners and live BBQ nights. Meal plans for every stay.

intro.label: Vegetarian · home-style
intro.title: Simple food, cooked with care
intro.text: Fresh paneer, slow-cooked dals, hot chapatis and seasonal vegetables. Breakfast by the water, lunch in the shade and dinner under the stars. Order to your cottage from the Guest App.

menu.item: Value combo, e.g. cold coffee + sandwich

menu_note: Per person. Open daily 8:30 AM – 10:30 PM.

meal_plans.label: Meal plans
meal_plans.title: Add meals to any stay
meal_plans.text: Breakfast is always included. Add lunch or dinner for ₹1,600, or all meals for ₹2,600, per room per night (Family Suite ₹2,400 / ₹3,900).
